scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @school-timetable/shared lint && pnpm --filter @school-timetable/database lint && pnpm --filter @school-timetable/web lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @school-timetable/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @school-timetable/database typecheck && pnpm --filter @school-timetable/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @school-timetable/shared test && pnpm --filter @school-timetable/database test && pnpm --filter @school-timetable/web test
scripts.solver:dev: uv run --project services/solver uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir services/solver --reload --port 8000
scripts.solver:format: uv run --project services/solver ruff format services/solver
scripts.solver:format:check: uv run --project services/solver ruff format --check services/solver
scripts.solver:lint: uv run --project services/solver ruff check services/solver
